decisions.reason: The IMU module is a new version of a sensor type the firm already knows well, it fits the modular building block system and API ecosystem, and the firm's own firmware and hardware expertise lets it refine the module from early feedback.

The industrial AC voltage input module builds directly on the firm's power and energy-measurement knowledge from its charging and energy-management work, and having a page of its own signals strategic commitment.

The four-channel solid state relay is a core automation building block that draws on long-held relay and control know-how, so the firm can easily interpret demand and improve it within its modular architecture.

The server room monitoring kit is assembled from existing sensor modules and so relies on related knowledge, but as a bundled application kit it is more exposed to being folded into other offerings or discontinued if demand is weak, which gives it a somewhat higher drop risk.
